name: Cleanup After Window
intent: Final inspect, scrape any paint that bled past the masking onto the glass, reinstall hardware, tear down floor protection, clean tools.
doctrine: Glass scrape (12 win/hr = 5 min/window) is the slowest cleanup step — every glass pane needs a razor scrape pass to remove any paint bleed-through. Hardware reinstall is symmetric with hardware protection in setup at 20 win/hr.
